sanskrit: pāṭhātsasyādiṣṭārtha lābhavāndhyātvā devīṃ sarasvatīmvāñchitaṃ phalamāpnoti salokenātrasaṃśayaḥpaṭhennityaṃsomṛtatvaṃ ca gacchatisuranāyaka vṛnda vandyamśivāyasutamīśvarasyapareśāmrūpāmparasya viṣṇoḥmātaḥ sundari ! bhakta kalpa latike ! śrīpādukāmādarātgandhodvartanamādareṇa taruṇī dattaṃgṛhāṇāmbike !snātvāprojvala gaṃdhakaṃ bhavatu te śrī sundari ! tanmukhegṛhāṇa varadāyini ! tripura sundari ! śrīpadecainaṃ nirmalamātanotu vasanam śrī sundari ! tvanmudevinyastaṃ mukuṭaṃ śirasyanudinaṃ dattonmadaṃ stūyatāmtaddivyauṣadhinirmitaṃ racayatu śrī śāmbhavi śrīpadervinirmita maghucchaderati karāmbuja sthāyinamrambhaḥ sāmbhavi saṃbhrameṇa vimalaṃ dattaṃ gṛhāṇāmbike !tāmrāmbhojanivāsinīṃ bhagavatīṃ śrī caṇḍikāṃ pūjayedhūpo'yaṃ surakāmini viracitaḥ śrīcaṇḍike ! tvanmukhenaivedyaṃ surakāminī viracitaṃ śrī caṇḍike ! tanmukhegṛhāṇa mukha paṅkaje sphurita gandha tāmbulakammahā tripura sundari ! prakaṭabhātapatraṃ mahatsve citte kriyamāṇa eva kurutāṃ śarmāṇi veda dhvaniḥ

sanskrit: pṛthvīmapsu upasaṃharāmi iti jale bhuvaṃ vilāpayetraṁ huṁ phaṭ iti triguṇāṃ tejo vāyāvupasaṃharāmi iti vahni vāyau vilāpayetvilāpayetityākāśamahaṃkāre vilāpayetvilāpayetprakṛtimātmanyupasaṃharāmi || ityanena māyāmātmani vilāpayetpāpapuruṣaṃ śoṣayet(64) dvātriṃśad (32) vāramāvartitena tadutthāgninā dahetjapitvā dakṣiṇanāḍyā tadbhasma svaśarīrādvahiḥ recayetkanakāṃḍavat bhāvayettasyamūrddhādi nakhāntā avayavāḥ manasā racanīyāḥprāṇaśaktiḥ parānaḥ || 1 || iti bhūtaśuddhiḥ ||mastakādārabhya hṛdayāntam (kroṃ) iti sṛṇi bījaṃ smaretmūrddhādi caraṇāvadhi vyāpakaṃ kuryāttataḥ oṃ maṃḍūkādi paratatvāṃta pīṭhadevatābhyo namaḥoṃ jayādi śaktibhyo namaḥśarīre caṇḍikā devatāyāḥ prāṇā iha sthitaḥ (prā.āḥ)ghrāṇa pāda pāyūpasthāni ihaivāgatyasukhaṃ ciraṃtiṣṭhantu svāhāsamarcayet || nyāsāttadātmakobhūtvā devībhūtvātu tāṃ yajet || 1 || āgneye ||prabhāṃ trinayanāṃvāgdevatāmāśraye || 1 || iti vahirmātṛkānyāsaḥ ||varābhaye pustakamakṣasūtraṃ bhajegiraṃ saṃdadhatīṃ trinetrāmgiraḥ khaḍgaṃ dadhatīṃ daśa vaktrakāmmālāñca paraśuṃ bāṇān gadāṃ kuliśameva cakheṭakaṃjalajaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ surāpātraṃ ca śūlakampadme sthitāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ bhaje mahiṣa mardinīm

sanskrit: dadhatīmujvalāṃ naumi devīṃ gaurī samudbhavāmcānye mama maṃtrasya siddhiṣuapasarpantu te sarve nirvighnāsiddhirastu memātaropyugrarūpāśca gaṇādhipatayaśca yete sarveprītimanasāḥ pratigṛhṇantvimaṃbalimsivesairrbhamardinīmiha mahālakṣmīṃ sarojasthitām || 2 ||] ||āvāhana mudrā lakṣaṇambhaktisnehaṃ samākṛṣṭa dīpavatsthāpayāmyahamsvātmasthāyaparaṃ śuddhamāsanaṃ kalpayāmyahamsānnidhyaṃ kuru tasyāṃ tvaṃ bhaktānugraha - tatpare !ātmānandaikatṛptāṃ tvāṃ niruṇadhmi pitaguroyadapūrṇaṃ bhavetkṛtyaṃ tadapyabhimukhī bhavamūrtau vā yajñasampūrtyai sthitābhava maheśvari !svatejaḥ puñjakenāśu veṣṭitābhava sarvataḥtasyai te parameśāyai svāgataṃ svāgataṃ ca teāgatā devi ! deveśi ! susvāgatamidaṃ punaḥtasyai te caraṇābjāyai pādyaṃ śuddhāya kalpayeācamanaṃ kalpayāmīśi ! śuddhānāṃ śuddhihetavetāpatrayavinirmuktaṃ tavārghyaṃ kalpayāmyaham svāhāmadhuparkamidaṃ devi ! kalpayāmi prasidīda meśuddhimāpnoti tasyai te punarācamanīyakamsarvalokeṣu śuddhātman ! dadāmi snehamuttamamudvartanaṃ mayādattaṃ snānārthaṃ pratigṛhyatāmkuśāgrairna kṣipettoyaṃ vajrapātasamaṃ bhavetpāvanaṃ yajñahetuśca payaḥ snānārthamarpitam
